Subform Verification Requirements:
1. Sofas must be sufficient, comfortable, and maintained in good condition (Refer to MMPC corporate Visual Identity (VI) manual for the color)
2. Room temperature must be minimum of 25°C; temperature must be displayed through a thermometer
3. Must have sufficient illumination (open lights during operations) and no busted lights
4. Must offer at least three kinds of complimentary beverage (water, coffee, and juice) and at least one kind of snack
5. Television must have media player or cable channels
6. There's an available Wi-Fi with a speed of at least 10 Mbps when measured using speed test (Measuring tool: https://www.speedtest.net/)
7. There are available power outlets for mobile phone, tablet, and laptop
8. Service customer lounge must observe 5S at all times
9. Customer restroom's cleanliness is maintained at all times, and with updated maintenance monitoring sheet (clean, no foul odor, etc.)
10. Customer restroom must have complete amenities (Minimum requirements: clean water supply, toilet bowl, sink, urinal, bidet, trash cans, air freshener and no foul odor, tissue, paper towel or hand dryer, hand wash soap, and hand sanitizer)
11. Signages must be clearly displayed and follows the latest VI design: “Customer Lounge”, “Complimentary Wi-Fi”, “Complimentary Beverages and Snacks”, “Charging Station”, “Customer Restroom”

Subject: MAM
CheckItem:
Are the following KPI being monitored and ready to be discussed in case its necessary during "Weekly Meeting"?: 

MAIN KPI:
1) Actual SIU and target agreed with MMPC
2) Actual first retention rate
3) Actual P&A booking and target agreed with MMPC
4) Stock month of fast moving parts
5) Appointment ratio
6) Dead stock ratio 
7) CSI

Technician Report:
8) Efficiency (labor sold hr / actual worked hr)
9) Utilization (actual worked hr / available hr)
10) Productivity (efficiency x utilization)

CRO/ Telemarketer:
11) Reminder call coverage ratio (actual reminder call / target reminder call)
12) Proactive call acceptance ratio (actual accepted appointment booking / called customer)
13) Follow up call ratio
14) Customer Complaint Tracking Discussion (Red alert, critical concerns)
15) Appointment balance for a day (Morning = 80%, Afternoon = 20%)

Job Controller: 
16) On time delivery and on time arrival ratio (from service time monitoring)

Others:
17) Fix it right first time or repeat repair ratio (F1)
18) Direct reception (optional)
19) Focus item upselling (optional)
BOMTask:
- Check if bulletin boards matches the MAM and MOM templates
follow up action plan and monitor compliance
HowToCheck: Check minutes of the meeting (quality)
